landing.headline: Location Intelligence.
landing.subheadline: Evaluate business viability, map local competitors, and generate a customized launch playbook for any location in seconds.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to find the
landing.featuresSubtitle: From competitor mapping to AI-powered strategic planning, our platform delivers actionable intelligence at every step.
landing.feature1Desc: Leverages Google Places API to discover and detail nearby competitor density, ratings, pricing levels, and distance proximity.
landing.feature2Desc: Generates a comprehensive strategic business plan including SWOT analysis, initial CapEx/OpEx financial estimates, risk assessment, and go-to-market strategies.
landing.feature3Desc: Provides an interactive chatbot trained on your location report. Ask questions and see data presented in clean tables and custom visual charts.
landing.feature4Desc: Save, track, and compare historical viability analyses to identify the ultimate site for your brand.
landing.workflowSubtitle: Three simple steps to a complete business viability analysis powered by real data and AI.
landing.step1Desc: Enter any address or pick a spot on the map, then select your business type and niche.
landing.step2Desc: Our system queries Google Geocoding and Nearby Search APIs to map every competitor in your radius with ratings, pricing, and distance.
landing.step3Desc: Mistral AI synthesizes all data into an overall viability score (0-100), a letter grade, SWOT analysis, and launches your full interactive dashboard.
landing.ctaSub: Get a comprehensive AI-powered site analysis in under 30 seconds — completely free.
landing.footerTag: Powered by Google Places API & Mistral AI
